name: hidden-role-rules
description: The rules of a hidden-role station game (working slug hidden-role), translated from the MIT-licensed upstream C#, on the portkit runtime. portkit/ is a copy of the shared kit.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run unit
scripts.golden: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning golden/extract.ts && dotnet run --project golden -c Release -- vectors/upstream.json src/station-map.json
